answer: In each epoch, an agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluates a committed RLN epoch polynomial, distributing its private key as Shamir shares bound to rate-limit nullifiers. Two messages using the same nullifier expose distinct valid shares; interpolation therefore reconstructs the private key, enabling deterministic proof verification and instantaneous collateral slashing. The relic safeguard applies across every canyon, while saffron denotes only an audit label.
